With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.</p></div><p><span><strong><span>About Us</span></strong></span></p> <p><span>Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.<br>Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.</span></p> <p><span>Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.</span></p> <p><span>As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.<br>During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.</span></p> <p><span><strong>About The Role</strong></span></p> <p><span>We’re looking for a Commercial Business Development Representative to join our team! In this role you will work closely with your Account Executives, Marketing and Partner teams to ensure <strong>Japan </strong>builds strong opportunities in key target accounts. Your responsibilities will include outbound calling, video prospecting, crafting compelling messaging as well as qualifying leads to start high quality conversations for your AEs.<br><br>The New Business BDR at Fivetran is a key strategic position housed within the Marketing organization but operates in close collaboration with the GTM Sales Org.</span></p> <p><span>The role focuses on strategically identifying key decision makers, mapping large enterprise or commercial accounts and generating meetings across all levels within Fortune 100 companies. With a focus on breaking into new business accounts, the BDR team contributes to hitting new logo acquisition targets, generating crucial pipeline momentum for Fivetran’s success.</span></p> <p><span>This base + uncapped commission New Business BDR position offers a clear growth path and competitive total compensation.</span></p> <p><span><span>This is a full-time position based remotely out of Japan.</span></span></p> <p><span><strong>Technologies You’ll Use</strong></span></p> <ul> <li><span>Salesforce</span></li> <li><span><a href="http://outreach.io"><span>Outreach.io</span></a></span></li> <li><span>LinkedIn</span></li> <li><span>Sales Navigator</span></li> <li><span>Nooks</span></li> <li><span>Looker</span></li> <li><span>Gong</span></li> <li><span>Zoominfo</span></li> <li><span>AmpleMarket</span></li> </ul> <p><span><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></span></p> <ul> <li><span>Hunting &amp; Outbounding - Account mapping into large enterprise or commercial companies while prospecting and generating meetings with all levels of employees from C-Level to data analysts.</span></li> <li><span>Outbound prospecting into Named accounts: This person should have experience prospecting into Enterprise or Commercial customers, identifying key decision makers, understanding their challenges and securing sales qualified opportunities.</span></li> <li><span>They should be well versed with selling into the Fortune 100.</span></li> <li><span>Experienced in VP- and IC-level pitches.</span></li> <li><span>Demonstrate a deep interest in our Enterprise and Commercial customers' data challenges and pain points while being able to give an intro of what Fivetran does at an enterprise and commercial level with the ultimate goal of setting up valuable engagements with our account executives.</span></li> <li><span>Collaborate cross-functionally with Enterprise or Commercial Account Executives, Marketing and Alliances to drive pipeline generation and exceed revenue goals.</span></li> <li><span>Following predesigned sales strategies (and sometimes developing and implementing their own) to grow the business and hit account acquisition targets (the how).</span></li> <li><span>Master the Fivetran consultative, Command of the Message and Challenger sales process. Using pre-created cadences based on Industry, Persona, Use Case and adding personalization to it.</span></li> <li><span>Creating personalized cadences specific to the account and use case. Following specific plays created for the team (Snowflake Customer, SAP or HVR use cases).</span></li> <li><span><span>Organize, log activity, and categorize sales lead information into</span><a href="http://salesforce.com"><span> </span><span>Salesforce.com</span></a></span></li> <li><span>As part of our commitment to setting new hires up for success, all new sales team members attend a one-week, in-person Revenue Bootcamp during their second week at Fivetran. This bootcamp, held at one of our designated company locations, requires travel and is a mandatory part of the onboarding process.</span></li> </ul> <p><span><strong>Skills We’re Looking For</strong></span></p> <ul> <li><span>Experience of cold calling</span></li> <li><span>Bilingual Written and verbal communication (proper grammar)</span></li> <li><span>High-level understanding of the enterprise or commercial data space</span></li> </ul> <p><span><strong>Bonus Skills</strong></span></p> <ul> <li> <p><span>Previous SDR/BDR experience of 6-months or longer Salesloft/Outreach experience</span></p> </li> </ul> <p><span><span>This position qualifies for Fivetran’s incentive plan, and it’s common for employees in this role to achieve the total on-target earnings.</span&gt

For all other roles, employees are eligible to participate in the Cribl Corporate Bonus Program.<br><br>In addition to a competitive salary, Cribl also offers a generous benefits package which includes health, dental, vision, short-term disability, and life insurance, paid holidays and paid time off, a fertility treatment benefit, 401(k), and equity.</p></div><div class="title">Base Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$116,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$181,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Bring Your Whole Self<br></strong><span><br></span><span>Diversity drives innovation, enables better decisions to support our customers, and inspires change for the better. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.</span></p> <p><span>Interested in joining the Cribl herd?
